properties.environment: Simulated closed-loop planning + retrospective clinical ultrasound (BUSI, BUV)

evidence_fragments.content: Experiments demonstrate improved prediction fidelity and action following. Across nine simulated closed-loop local planning episodes, UltraWorld reduces the mean final distance to the goal and orientation error by 29% and 38%, respectively, compared with visual servoing.

In this section, we present UltraWorld, a recipe for learning interactive ultrasound world models from action-free clinical videos. Our key idea is to transfer the visual and temporal priors learned from clinical videos into action-conditioned dynamics through anatomy-guided interaction supervision. We further introduce a pixel-aligned representation of ultrasound acquisition to explicitly encode the spatial effects of diverse clinical scanning operations.

locator.section_or_table: Section 4.3 Self-Distillation for Ultrasound World Modeling

evidence_fragments.content: we transform the mask-conditioned ultrasound generator into an action-conditioned world model by replacing mask conditioning with AsMap while retaining the observation input (Fig. 4). We initialize the world-model backbone from the teacher, θ 0 ←ϕ ∗, and train it on the synthesized trajectories to model p θ(Xf |X c,G f ). For optimization, we first train the AsMap encoder Φ with the video backbone frozen and then jointly fine-tune both.

locator.section_or_table: Section 5.4 UltraWorld for Robotic Ultrasound Planning

evidence_fragments.content: we evaluate UltraWorld for goal-directed local ultrasound planning in simulation. We use model predictive control (MPC) (Mayne et al., 2000), optimizing candidate probe-action sequences with the cross-entropy method (CEM) (De Boer et al., 2005). We compare against an intensity-based visual-servoing baseline inspired by Nadeau & Krupa (2013); implementation details are provided in Appendix C. Across nine episodes, UltraWorld achieves lower mean terminal translation and rotation errors than visual servoing (Fig. 7).

[paraphrase (visual p.9)] Figure 7 bar plots show closed-loop planning terminal errors: UltraWorld + CEM achieves 2.75 mm translation error and 3.65 deg rotation error versus 3.86 mm and 5.86 deg for the Visual Servo Baseline. Table 3 reports real clinical ultrasound consistency LPIPS for AsMap (Ours): BUSI zero-action 0.042, round-trip 0.062; BUV zero-action 0.059, round-trip 0.076.
We present UltraWorld, a self-distillation recipe that transfers priors from clinical ultrasound videos into interactive world models without real action annotations.

evidence_fragments.content: The mask-conditioned ultrasound generator is initialized from Wan2.1-FunControl-1.3B-V1.1 (Wan Team et al., 2025). All models are trained on a single NVIDIA H200 GPU using 512×512 videos with 17 frames per clip and a batch size of 8.

capability_assessments.rationale: Action-conditioned ultrasound world model (AsMap) coupled with CEM-MPC closed-loop planning evaluated across 9 simulated episodes (in-silico R1 only; synthetic L4 control does not establish clinical efficacy).

scope.note: Closed-loop CEM-MPC planning evaluated in 9 simulated episodes; BUSI/BUV consistency evaluated retrospectively (R2).

limitations: Closed-loop planning evaluated only in 9 simulated episodes, not on physical phantoms or human subjects.
Synthetic action-video pairs are generated from MR-derived 3D anatomy rather than real tracked ultrasound.

legacy_cells.B: UltraWorld: Learning Interactive Ultrasound World Models from Untracked Clinical Videos with Acoustic Sampling Map
legacy_cells.C: Yang, Keke, Wang, Erqi, Guan, Sainan, Ren, Hongliang
legacy_cells.S: Can future ultrasound observations be predicted under prescribed probe/acquisition trajectories, and can closed-loop planning reach a target view in simulation?
legacy_cells.V: Select probe-action sequences to move toward a target ultrasound view.
legacy_cells.AI: Ultrasound video frames; initial/reference ultrasound image; text condition; probe pose and imaging configuration represented as AsMap (pixel-wise 3D sampling positions, beam directions, and depths).
legacy_cells.AJ: Wan2.1-FunControl video-transformer backbone; pretrained VAE and image/text encoders; AsMap geometry encoder (convolution + ResBlock).
legacy_cells.AM: AsMap geometry features are added to patch-embedded video features before the first transformer block; initial-frame and text conditioning are retained.
legacy_cells.BD: Probe pose (SE(3)); scan geometry; physical sampling scale; imaging depth or field of view; beam steering.
legacy_cells.BF: Candidate probe trajectories are restricted to feasible motions under environment motion constraints.
legacy_cells.BL: 17-frame clips; planning predictions use 16-step motion trajectories.
legacy_cells.BN: Pixel-aligned AsMap encodes physical sampling positions, acoustic beam directions, and sampling depths; synthetic anatomy masks are sampled from 3D volumes along programmed trajectories.
legacy_cells.BS: Predicted future ultrasound video frames, decoded from video latents.
legacy_cells.BU: Planning cost: 0.7 × LPIPS to goal at predicted step 4 + 0.3 × LPIPS to goal at predicted step 8.
legacy_cells.BV: Conditional flow matching; future-latent MSE objective (MSEfuture between predicted flow velocity and noise-minus-clean latent).
legacy_cells.CA: Training used a single NVIDIA H200 GPU; mask-conditioned generator trained 2K steps and world model 10K steps.
legacy_cells.CI: 16-step motion trajectory; four action blocks repeated for four steps each.
legacy_cells.CK: Minimize weighted predicted-image LPIPS to the goal (0.7 at step 4, 0.3 at step 8), subject to feasible environment motions.
legacy_cells.EB: Alternative prescribed acquisition trajectories (sweep, slide, rock, depth change) from the same initial observation produced distinct predicted anatomical evolutions; the authors report improved action following with AsMap.
legacy_cells.EC: In nine simulated closed-loop episodes, UltraWorld reduced mean final distance-to-goal and orientation error by 29% and 38%, respectively, versus visual servoing.
legacy_cells.EI: Compared with visual servoing + CEM in simulated planning: UltraWorld reduced mean final distance-to-goal and orientation error by 29% and 38% over nine episodes.
legacy_cells.EJ: Compared action-conditioning encodings (Fourier, MLP, PRoPE): authors report AsMap had the best prediction-fidelity and action-following performance.
legacy_cells.EK: Ablated matched-size MLP action conditioning and Wan2.1 initialization versus the full model.
legacy_cells.EO: Ethics statement says the work used publicly available datasets and no personally identifiable information.
legacy_cells.FB: Initial ultrasound observation conditions a video latent; acquisition state is represented by pixel-aligned seven-channel AsMap geometry.
legacy_cells.FL: Initial ultrasound frame and acquisition trajectory are encoded as video conditioning and pixel-aligned AsMap; a flow-matching video transformer predicts future ultrasound frames; a CEM-based MPC scores candidate rollouts by goal-image LPIPS and executes a short prefix before re-observing and replanning.
legacy_cells.FM: Self-distill an ultrasound video prior learned from untracked clinical videos using anatomy-guided synthetic action-video trajectories; introduce AsMap to encode probe pose and imaging configuration as pixel-wise sampling geometry.
legacy_cells.FN: Across nine simulated closed-loop planning episodes, reported mean final distance-to-goal and orientation error reductions were 29% and 38% versus visual servoing. AsMap is reported best across prediction-fidelity and action-following metrics; real-initial-frame tests report lower zero-action and round-trip LPIPS on BUSI and BUV.
legacy_cells.FO: Training relies mainly on generator-synthesized rather than tracked real action-video trajectories, so generator errors or biases may propagate. AsMap omits tissue-dependent scattering, attenuation, and speckle and assumes calibrated pose/imaging geometry. Real-data evaluation lacks paired futures; robotic planning is simulation-only and uses a limited number of episodes.
legacy_cells.FP: Future work: use some tracked clinical data for calibration and validation, extend to broader anatomical and device domains, and validate on physical robotic systems.
legacy_cells.FQ: Routine clinical ultrasound videos generally lack probe-motion records, while action-supervised world models rely on synchronized ultrasound-pose recordings; pose-only conditioning also omits imaging-scale sampling changes.
legacy_cells.FR: Evidence supports action-conditioned video prediction and simulated closed-loop planning, not physical-robot performance or prospective clinical benefit. Real clinical tests assess stability/round-trip consistency without paired futures; conditioning on alternative trajectories is not causal identification.
legacy_cells.FS: Reviewer mapping: M3 Belief-state service; M4 Action service; M5 Dynamics adapter; M6 Rollout service; M7 Outcome & causal layer; M8 Planner; M9 Safety & governance
legacy_cells.FT: Reviewer lesson: Keep the learned patient/scene simulator separate from the planner objective; constrain candidate actions and report closed-loop decision quality alongside model fidelity.
legacy_cells.FX: Title and abstract (PDF p. 1); introduction and related work (pp. 1–3); preliminaries and methods (pp. 3–6); experimental setup, results, and tables/figures (pp. 7–9); ethics/reproducibility statements (p. 10); implementation and planning algorithms (pp. 16–17); data/evaluation details (pp. 18–20); additional results and limitations (pp. 21–23). | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text.
